en.headline: Man, 45, dies after rescue off Kwun Tong public pier
en.dek: Rescuers pulled an unconscious man from the water on Thursday night after a report that someone had fallen into the sea. He was later certified dead at hospital.
body: A 45-year-old man died after being pulled from the sea off Kwun Tong public pier on Thursday night, according to police and local reports.

Police received a report at about 9pm on 17 September that someone was suspected to have fallen into the water about 10 metres off the pier. Firefighters recovered the man, who was unconscious, and he was taken to United Hospital, where he was later certified dead. Officers said no suicide note was found at the scene.

Police said they were investigating the circumstances. The cause of death had not been determined and would be subject to a post-mortem examination. Authorities have not given a reason for the man entering the water.

zh.headline: 觀塘公眾碼頭救起45歲男子 送院後不治
zh.dek: 救援人員週四晚上在碼頭對開海面救起昏迷男子，送往聯合醫院後證實死亡，警方正調查事發經過。
body: 一名45歲男子週四晚上在觀塘公眾碼頭對開海面被救起，其後於醫院證實死亡。
警方晚上約9時接報，指有人懸疑在碼頭對開約10米海面墮海。消防將該名昏迷男子救起，送往聯合醫院搶救，其後證實不治。警員在現場沒有檢獲遺書。
警方正調查事發經過。死因有待驗屍確定，當局未有交代男子墮海原因。
